$comment: Machine-readable protocol constants that are NOT JSON-Schema shapes but are part of the versioned wire contract. The BACKEND owns this file; the frontend MUST vendor and READ these values rather than hardcoding its own copies. csrf_header is the request header the SPA echoes the CSRF token in (see src/access/csrf.ts CSRF_HEADER). session_cookie_default is the default SESSION_COOKIE_NAME from src/config.ts. csrf_cookie_suffix is appended to the session cookie name to form the readable CSRF cookie (see src/access/cookies.ts csrfCookieName). Covered by contract/digest.mjs so a change here changes schemas_sha256.
